rootCause: MyTimeController.getMonth binds the required `month` query param as a raw `@Query('month') monthStr: string` with no validation pipe, then passes it to parseMonthQuery() in src/modules/timesheets/application/contracts/month.query.ts. When the param is omitted, monthStr is undefined and `month.match(YEAR_MONTH_PATTERN)` throws `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'match')`. When the param is present but malformed (e.g. 'June' or ''), parseMonthQuery explicitly `throw new Error('Invalid month format: ...')`. Both are plain (Type)Errors, not BadRequestException, so Nest's exception filter maps them to HTTP 500 instead of 400. With the exact UI wire (month=YYYY-MM) the endpoint returns 200, and personId is the only param the UI ever omits (and that one IS defaulted to req.principal.personId), so this is NOT reachable via the real UI -- it is purely a missing/invalid-input crash that should be a 400.

suggestedFix: The fix already exists but is unused: bind `@Query() query: MonthQueryDto` (defined in month.query.ts with @IsString + @Matches(YYYY-MM)) instead of `@Query('month') monthStr: string`, relying on the global ValidationPipe to return a 400 on missing/malformed month. Then derive year/month via parseMonthQuery(query.month) (now guaranteed valid). Apply the same change to getGaps/autoFill/copyPrevious which share the same parseMonthQuery crash, and ideally have parseMonthQuery throw BadRequestException rather than a bare Error.
